ops.name: Bookkeeper
ops.description: Staff member who prepares and sends monthly invoices to clients.

ops.name: Firm Owner
ops.description: Owner who reviews billing, adjusts rates, and tracks payments.

ops.name: Client
ops.description: Business that receives and pays monthly bookkeeping invoices.

ops.name: Client
ops.description: A business the firm does bookkeeping for.
ops.example: Acme LLC, billing@acme.com, $450/mo, billed on the 1st

ops.name: Invoice
ops.description: A monthly bill sent to a client.
ops.example: Invoice #1042 for Acme LLC, $450, sent Mar 1, due Mar 15

ops.name: Line Item
ops.description: A single charge on an invoice.
ops.example: Monthly bookkeeping, 1 x $450 = $450

ops.name: Payment
ops.example: $450 received Mar 12 by bank transfer for Invoice #1042

ops.name: Service
ops.description: A recurring or one-off bookkeeping service that can be billed.
ops.example: Payroll processing, $75, recurring monthly

ops.name: Statement
ops.description: A summary of a client's invoices and payments over a period.
ops.example: Acme LLC, Q1, billed $1,350, paid $900, balance $450
Bookkeeper creates Invoice #1042 for Acme LLC for March
Bookkeeper adds 'Monthly bookkeeping $450' to Invoice #1042
Bookkeeper emails Invoice #1042 to Acme on Mar 1
Bookkeeper records $450 received for Invoice #1042
Bookkeeper marks Invoice #1042 paid once payment covers it
Bookkeeper adds new client Beta Corp with $600/mo fee
Owner sets payroll processing rate to $75
Owner raises Acme's monthly fee to $500
Owner reviews Q1 statement for Acme showing $450 balance
Bookkeeper voids a duplicate Invoice #1043
Acme receives Invoice #1042 by email

ops.text: Every invoice number must be unique and never reused, even after a void.
ops.example: Voiding #1043 does not free up the number for reuse

ops.text: An invoice's amount due must equal the sum of its line items.
ops.example: Invoice #1042 total is $450 because its only line is $450

ops.text: An invoice cannot be marked paid until recorded payments equal or exceed the amount due.
ops.example: #1042 stays unpaid until $450 is recorded

ops.text: An invoice cannot be edited after it has been sent to a client; corrections require a void and reissue.
ops.example: After sending #1042, changing the amount requires voiding and reissuing

ops.text: Only the Firm Owner may change a client's monthly fee or service rates.
ops.example: A Bookkeeper cannot raise Acme's fee to $500

ops.text: Payments cannot exceed the invoice amount due.
ops.example: A $500 payment cannot be applied to a $450 invoice without an overpayment note

ops.text: Each invoice must be linked to exactly one existing client.
ops.example: An invoice cannot be created for a client not on file

ops.text: Clients are only billed once per billing period unless the owner approves an extra invoice.
ops.example: Acme gets one March invoice unless owner authorizes a second

ops.text: Does not process credit card or online payments; payments are recorded manually.
Does not let clients log in to a portal; they only receive invoices by email.
Does not calculate or file taxes.
Does not track the firm's own bookkeeping work hours or time entries.
Does not handle payroll or accounting beyond issuing invoices.
